items.mainDefect: Synchronous device tagging blocks anonymous authentication on a database write, adding request latency.

secondary.defect: Removing the tagging panic guard allows a tagging panic to propagate into authentication.

items.mainDefect: Using the request context removes tagging’s independent two-minute timeout, leaving its deadline dependent on the caller.

secondary.defect: Removing the tagging panic guard allows a tagging panic to propagate into authentication.
